The discussion centered on demonstrating a new AI feature. Initially, the plan was to show a more advanced version in two weeks (monitoring tools and a text-to-SQL capability added by someone). However, [me] agreed that showing a minimal assistant version sooner would be beneficial for gathering feedback.

Someone suggested starting with a simpler helper that answers questions about metrics before moving into complex data querying. This approach was deemed relatively easy to implement.
decisions: Demonstrate a minimal AI assistant version tomorrow (or soon) to gather early feedback.
